title: Delhi to Udaipur Bus: Fare, Timing and Route Guide
summary: Plan your Delhi to Udaipur bus journey with fare examples, travel time, NCR boarding points, cab pickup details and Udaipur arrival advice.
body_markdown:
A 5 PM bus listing can still require you to reach a cab pickup point at 2:30 PM. That detail matters when booking a Delhi to Udaipur bus after work, especially if you are starting in Noida, Rohini or Faridabad.


## **What to Know Before Choosing Your Departure**


This is an overnight journey, so the useful comparison includes your starting point in NCR, the actual pickup time, the seat you will sleep in and the morning arrival. A cheaper listing can become less convenient once local transfers enter the plan.


Begin with the[Delhi to Udaipur booking page](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/delhi-to-udaipur-bus-route) , enter your travel date and open the service details. The route summary gives a starting reference, while the selected bus timeline and ticket provide the stop information you need for the journey.


# **Delhi to Udaipur Bus Planning for Fares, Pickups and Morning Arrivals**


Read the departure time alongside the full timeline before paying. The sample below shows why two passengers booking the same coach may need to leave home at very different hours, even though both see the same departure on the search card.


## **Delhi to Udaipur Bus Fare and Timing**


On 6 October 2026, a live search for travel on 7 October showed the following three services. These are dated examples of the displayed schedule and pre-coupon fares, rather than a fixed timetable or a quote for another travel date.


**Search Card Departure** **Search Card Arrival the Next Day** **Listed Duration** **Displayed Fare Before Coupon Reduction**


5:00 PM 5:45 AM 12 hours 45 minutes ₹531


9:00 PM 9:30 AM 12 hours 30 minutes ₹708


9:55 PM 10:30 AM 12 hours 35 minutes ₹895


Prices are approximate and may vary based on season, demand, and availability.


The cards also displayed coupon reductions. Your selected seat, eligible offer, cab transfer and any applicable checkout additions can change the payable amount. Compare the final total after selecting the journey details, rather than budgeting only for the first number you see.


An early departure can bring you into Udaipur before hotel check-in. A later departure may fit an office day better, but only if its actual pickup time works. Neither option is automatically better value once local travel and accommodation arrangements are included.


## **Boarding Points Across Delhi and NCR**


Delhi to Udaipur bus boarding points include direct coach stops and locations marked “Pickup by Cab”. Treat that label as part of the journey arrangement. The nearest location on a map may require a transfer before you join the intercity coach.


### **Where You Join the Coach**


The route page lists Kashmere Gate ISBT, Jhandewalan Metro Station, Dhaula Kuan and the start of Mahipalpur Flyover among the Delhi stops without a cab pickup label. Check which of these your chosen service actually offers before arranging transport there.


Kashmere Gate has a specific landmark: zingbus Booking Counter No. 28 inside ISBT, with the page referring to Metro exits 7 and 8. Dhaula Kuan is listed in front of the DSOI office. Use your ticket’s directions and map pin to find the stop.


Do not assume the search card time applies to every boarding point. In the checked 5 PM service timeline, Kashmere Gate appeared at 4 PM, Dhaula Kuan at 5 PM and Mahipalpur at 5:25 PM. Your selected stop determines when you must be there.


### **What “Pickup by Cab” Means**


Examples of cab pickup locations include Amity University and Axis House in Noida, Botanical Garden, Rithala Metro Station in Rohini and selected Faridabad stops. Availability depends on the service, so choose an option shown for your booking rather than relying on this illustrative list.


On eligible services, a shared cab connects the selected pickup location with the bus boarding point. Available transfer charges appear during booking and are added to the ticket total. Check the selected location, pickup time and transfer instructions together before paying.


For the checked 5 PM service, Pacific Mall Faridabad’s cab pickup appeared at 2:30 PM, while Botanical Garden appeared at 3:15 PM. That is a substantial difference from the headline departure. Someone finishing work at 4 PM could miss either pickup.


Leave enough time to find the exact landmark with your luggage. Follow the reporting instructions on the ticket, save a screenshot of the pickup address and keep the support contact accessible. Being near the metro station does not necessarily mean you have reached the meeting point.


## **Choosing a Seat You Can Sleep In**


The best bus for Delhi to Udaipur is the one whose timing, seat layout and boarding arrangement fit your trip. Start with how you sleep and how easily you can climb into a berth, then compare the facilities listed for that specific coach.


### **Sleeper Berth or Semi-Sleeper Seat**


The checked services were labelled Bharat Benz AC Semi-Sleeper/Sleeper with washroom. A combined coach description does not mean every ticket buys a berth. Open the seat map and confirm whether the selected position is a reclining seat, single berth or shared berth.


A sleeper berth lets you lie down, while a semi-sleeper means spending the night in a reclining seat. Lower berths can be easier to access if climbing is difficult. Travelling alone? Check the berth’s occupancy and layout before selecting a shared sleeping space.


### **Check the Actual Coach Amenities**


The first service’s details listed a charging point, water bottle, live tracking, blanket and washroom. Read the amenities for your own departure before booking. A facility advertised elsewhere on the website should not be treated as an inclusion on every route or coach.


Carry a charged power bank, a light layer and any essentials you need overnight in a small bag that stays with you. Eat before boarding if that suits your schedule, and check meal arrangements separately when choosing the service.


## **Distance, Rajasthan Route and Travel Time**


The Delhi to Udaipur distance listed on the zingbus route page is approximately 676 km. Your exact journey distance depends on where you board and get off, so use the chosen service’s timeline alongside the route summary.


The checked coach timeline travelled through Gurgaon, Jaipur, Nasirabad, Gulabpura, Bhilwara, Rajsamand and Nathdwara before Udaipur. This is a through journey with intermediate stops. Passing through Jaipur does not mean you need to book a separate onward bus for the verified services.


Delhi to Udaipur bus duration was around 12½ to 12¾ hours on the checked search cards. Allow for traffic, intermediate pickups, breaks and road conditions. A general driving estimate does not include all the operational details of an overnight coach journey.


Your own time on board can differ from the headline duration because you may join at an earlier stop or leave at a later Udaipur stop. Add the local journey from home and the transfer to your hotel when planning the complete trip.


## **Choosing Your Udaipur Drop Point**


The route lists Amberi Puliya Bypass, Bhuvana Circle, the area in front of Ananta Medical College and Near Reti Stand Circle. Compare the options available on your selected service with your accommodation address before deciding where to get off.


Arrival time also changes by stop. In the checked early service, Ananta Medical College appeared at 5:45 AM and Near Reti Stand Circle at 6:15 AM. The first arrival shown on a search card may therefore differ from the time at your booked stop.


Ask your hotel which listed drop point works best for its location and whether it can arrange a pickup. Confirm the meeting landmark, vehicle access and total transfer charge in advance. Keep the hotel’s contact number and address available offline for the morning arrival.


### **Make the First Morning Manageable**


For an arrival before dawn or early in the morning, ask about reception hours, luggage storage and early check-in before travelling. An overnight ticket does not guarantee immediate access to a hotel room. Get a clear answer about any additional accommodation charge.


Once you have rested, keep the first outing small. City Palace stands along Lake Pichola’s eastern bank, making that area a possible starting point for sightseeing. Save the longer attraction list for the[Udaipur lakes, palaces and food guide](https://www.zingbus.com/blog/places-to-visit-in-udaipur-lakes-palaces-food/) .


Avoid paying for a tightly timed sightseeing pickup immediately after the scheduled bus arrival. Leave room for the local transfer, breakfast and a change of clothes. A short first outing is easier to adjust if the journey runs later than expected.


## **Book the Journey With All Stops Selected**


Once the departure and arrival arrangements work, book your ticket with the complete itinerary in view. Selecting the seat, boarding location and drop point before reviewing the total helps you compare the journey you will actually take.


1. Enter Delhi, Udaipur and your departure date on the booking page or app.
2. Open the bus details and compare the full timeline with your available travel window.
3. Select the correct seat type, boarding location and Udaipur drop point.
4. Review any cab transfer charge, eligible offer and final payable amount.
5. Read the cancellation conditions for the selected ticket before payment.
6. Save the confirmation with the seat number, reporting time, stop address and support details.


For a round trip, check the[Udaipur to Delhi return service](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/udaipur-to-delhi-bus-route) separately. Its available stops and times need their own review. Leave enough time between your final city activity and the reporting time for that return ticket.


## **Let the Ticket Shape Your First Day in Udaipur**


The most useful choice connects three things: a pickup you can reach, a seat suited to an overnight journey and an arrival that works with your hotel. A small fare saving is less valuable if it creates a difficult local transfer or an unexpected room charge.


Before setting off, check the ticket once more and share the confirmed arrival details with your accommodation. With those arrangements settled, you can give Udaipur a slower first morning and begin exploring the lakes and palace area after you have rested.


## **Questions About Overnight Travel to Udaipur**


These answers cover the decisions travellers often need to settle before booking, particularly fares, seat types, NCR pickups and what happens on arrival in Udaipur.


### **How Much Does a Ticket Cost?**


A Delhi to Udaipur bus fare depends on the date, selected seat and offers; use the final checkout amount for your budget.


### **What Are the Evening Departure Options?**


Evening departure examples were 5 PM, 9 PM and 9:55 PM in the search; your selected boarding point has its own time.


### **How Long Does the Overnight Journey Take?**


The scheduled overnight journey was approximately 12½ to 12¾ hours; allow extra time for local transfers, your selected stops and possible delays.


### **What Is the Road Distance Between Delhi and Udaipur?**


The road distance for the listed service is approximately 676 km; the exact journey varies with your boarding point and destination stop.


### **Can I Join the Coach at Kashmere Gate?**


Kashmere Gate appears among the route’s boarding options; check your service and use the ticket’s counter landmark, map pin and reporting time.


### **Can I Start From a Noida Pickup Point?**


Noida pickup options include selected locations marked Pickup by Cab; confirm their availability, transfer charge and earlier pickup time for your service.


### **Is the Cab Pickup Time the Same as the Bus Departure?**


Cab pickup time can be much earlier than the bus departure; follow the selected stop’s timeline and confirmed ticket instructions when travelling.


### **Are Sleeper Berths Available on This Route?**


Sleeper berths appeared in the checked mixed semi-sleeper and sleeper coaches; use the seat map to confirm the accommodation you are selecting.


### **Can I Book a Lower Berth?**


A lower berth can be booked when available in the seat map; verify its position, occupancy and price before confirming your ticket.


### **Do the Checked Buses Have a Washroom?**


The checked buses were labelled with washroom, and the first service’s amenities confirmed it; review the details of your own selected coach.


### **Will My Bus Drop Me at My Hotel?**


A hotel drop should be arranged separately unless explicitly included in your booking; select the listed stop that suits your accommodation location.


### **Can I Sightsee Immediately After Arrival?**


Sightseeing after arrival depends on rest, hotel access and actual arrival time; avoid fixed early bookings that leave no room for delays.


### **Can I Change My Boarding Point After Booking?**


Boarding point changes require contacting support as early as possible; approval depends on the service, so wait for confirmation before changing plans.
